title: Beginners' Italian I
description: Introduces Italian language and culture. Special emphasis on the historical and current cultural, social and political aspects of the Italian language by way of film, music and readings; supports language acquisition towards the A1.1 level of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages. No previous knowledge of Italian needed.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ITAL 100A, ITAL 100, ITAL 149.
Priority is given to students with first- or second-year standing.
